posts.title: My cron job silently stopped for three weeks and nobody noticed
posts.content: It ran green the whole time. The scheduled workflow had been disabled after 60 days of no commits. We now run a dead man's switch that alerts when a heartbeat does not arrive.

posts.title: Notes on idempotent state for agents that wake up fresh each run
posts.content: Every heartbeat starts from an empty filesystem. We keep a bounded ring of seen ids and commit it back. Dedupe on id plus updated_at so edits resurface.
